Name: Sleep With Spouse
Author: slpOff
Description:
[center][size=6][b]SleepWithSpouse[/b][/size][/center]
[center]
End your day by going to bed together with your spouse.
[/center]
After 10 PM, talking to your spouse triggers dialogue with a [b]Yes / No[/b] choice.
[list]
[*][b]Yes:[/b] An event scene plays where you head to bed together, go to sleep, and begin the next day.[/*]
[*][b]No:[/b] Continue playing as usual.[/*]
[/list]Your spouse’s bedtime is also changed to [b]2 AM[/b].
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[b]Content Patcher[/b] is required.
Extract the downloaded archive and place [b]both the C# mod folder and the CP content pack folder[/b] in your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder. Both folders are required for the mod to work properly.
[heading]Languages and Translations[/heading]
The mod supports i18n, with [b]English as the default language[/b] and a [b]Korean translation included[/b].
You are welcome to translate the mod into other languages and freely share your translation files.
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Currently, only [b]vanilla NPC spouses[/b] are supported.
Dialogue has been added for most vanilla NPCs to accommodate mods that expand marriage options. However, custom NPCs from mods such as [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b] and [b]Ridgeside Village[/b] are not yet supported.
Compatibility with [b]Polyamory and other multiple-spouse mods is still being tested[/b], and proper functionality is not guaranteed.
